neighbours.label: 'If' opening a conditional in safety or health instructions ('If the alarm goes off, ...')
fire: Store cleaning products in a high cupboard. If a child drinks bleach, call an ambulance.
Test the carbon monoxide detector monthly. If it sounds, open the windows and leave.
Wash your hands after handling raw meat. If you feel ill, see a doctor.
Keep the fire extinguisher by the kitchen door. If the pan catches fire, cover it.
Do not leave candles unattended. If smoke fills the room, crawl low to the exit.
Check the stove before bed. If you smell gas, do not switch on the lights.
Take the tablets with food. If a rash appears, stop taking them at once.
Keep the pool gate locked. If someone falls in, shout for help.
quiet: Store cleaning products in a high cupboard. We bought a new mop last week.
Test the carbon monoxide detector monthly. Mine is a white plastic box.
Wash your hands after handling raw meat. My brother loves barbecues.
Keep the fire extinguisher by the kitchen door. Ours is bright red.
Do not leave candles unattended. My sister collects scented ones.
Check the stove before bed. Our stove is about ten years old.
Take the tablets with food. I usually have mine at breakfast.
Keep the pool gate locked. We painted ours blue last summer.

notes: Near misses keep the safety-advice first sentence and drop the conditional.
